plugins.name: brief
plugins.description: Product setup before any code exists: state the product in one claim and state its refusals, test it against unlike uses so that no capability enters for a single case, turn it into a numbered proof a stranger can run, order the slices so the first one carries a consumer end to end, and lay the entry point, product document, decision records and invariant registry every later decision is read from.

plugins.name: paseo-cto
plugins.description: A fast CTO loop for Claude Code and Codex: dispatch plan tasks to isolated Paseo agents, accept by risk, land each accepted branch with one command that merges, checks, marks the board, pushes and watches the rollout, and report one status line. Models and effort remain owner decisions.

plugins.name: russian-speech
plugins.description: Coherent Russian technical prose after long work or context compaction: reconstruct meaning from working notes instead of translating them literally. Preserve technical terms and facts without inventing causes or completed actions.

plugins.name: team
plugins.description: Delivery discipline for a small project, in one file and with no fleet machinery: split work into outcomes that can be judged, size each check to what a defect would cost, prove a check can fail before trusting it, delegate reads in parallel and writes one at a time, review a change before it lands, and let the reviewer and the author converge across up to two returns before deciding on that record.
